description: This is a PHP source file for managing import of custom fields in the TestLink project. It handles file uploads, XML parsing, creation of custom fields, and permission checking.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for handling custom field database operations such as create and retrieval by name.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty templating object used to render views.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Class for handling input parameters, specifically string type in this context.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments, sets default values, and prepares return object.

methods.name: doImport
methods.description: Handles the import of custom fields from an uploaded XML file, including file upload handling, XML parsing, and database insertion.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has the right to manage custom fields.
